name: hermes-moa
description: Configure Hermes Agent Mixture-of-Agents presets over CLIProxyAPI-backed Grok 4.6 and Gemini 3.7 Flash.

interface.shortDescription: Use Grok and Gemini together in Hermes Agent
interface.longDescription: Configure two fail-closed Hermes Agent Mixture-of-Agents presets over one CLIProxyAPI provider: Gemini advises while Grok acts, or Grok advises while Gemini acts. Upstream accounts and credentials remain entirely inside CLIProxyAPI.
defaultPrompt: Set up Hermes MoA with Grok leading
Switch Hermes MoA to Gemini leading
